code_paper_alignment.methodology_describ.reason: The paper materially misdescribes the production assembly architecture. It claims workers write covariance column blocks directly into POSIX shared memory without serialization. The submitted production engine instead allocates and factorizes private segment matrices in workers, then returns likelihood contributions and solution vectors through multiprocessing Pool.map. This changes the described mechanism underlying the computational implementation, although the kernel mathematics agrees.
